description: This Java class serializes LoanRepaymentBusinessEvent objects into an Avro-compatible format (LoanRepaymentDueDataV1). It constructs data transfer objects with loan repayment details, including overdue and due amounts, and supports external custom data serializers. The class is used within a microservice architecture for event-driven loan repayment processing.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts LoanRepaymentBusinessEvent objects into Avro format for external event communication, including methods for data mapping and custom data collection.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a generic BusinessEvent to its Avro data transfer object representation, assembling loan repayment details and overdue data.

methods.name: getRepaymentDueData
methods.description: Builds the repayment due data object with installment details such as due date, principal, interest, fees, penalties, and total amount.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the event is an instance of LoanRepaymentBusinessEvent, indicating the serializer's applicability.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the Avro schema class this serializer supports, namely LoanRepaymentDueDataV1.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides a list of external custom data serializers used to extend the serialization process.
